topic: Exactly 4 characters (Military Husband, Seductive Wife, The Lover, Street Vendor). The story starts with a handsome military husband in a great mood at an outdoor street stall. He hands a few cash bills to the friendly Street Vendor to purchase a beautiful bouquet in a clear glass vase. The husband tells the vendor how excited he is because he is finally returning home after a very long deployment to surprise his wife. He walks to his house, opens the door sneakily with the glass vase of flowers behind his back. He enters the bedroom and freezes. The camera focuses on his extremely attractive, seductive wife and another man. The lover holds her head, slowly kisses her, stares deeply into her eyes, and then aggressively tongue kisses her again. The camera does a cinematic rack focus, unblurring the husband standing frozen in the background. The vase trembles in his hands. He is heartbroken. The wife notices him, steps away, but shows absolutely no remorse. She arrogantly slaps divorce papers hard against his chest and says in a cold, bitchy voice that he provides nothing compared to her lover and that she has already signed them. The husband asks with tears in his eyes what he did wrong. She cruelly replies that her lover does wonders for her that he never could. She leaves with the lover. We see a cinematic establishing drone shot of the lover's expensive car speeding away. Back inside, the husband drops to his knees in the empty room, utterly shattered. He cries for a moment, head in his hands. But then he stands up slowly. He wipes his tears, and his face twists from sorrow into pure, unhinged, dead-eyed anger. He violently slams the glass flower vase onto the hardwood floor, shattering it into a million pieces. He turns and walks out through the bedroom doorway in a cold daze. The camera follows him as he walks down the dark hallway to the basement door. The camera switches to a cinematic low-angle shot from deep inside the pitch-black basement, looking up the wooden stairs as his dark silhouette slowly descends into the shadows. He reaches the bottom and grabs a heavy sledgehammer resting against the brick wall. In a gritty 'John Wick' style action sequence lit by a single harsh bulb, he violently smashes open the concrete floor, dust and debris flying everywhere, to unearth a hidden heavy metal suitcase. He pops the latches and opens it to reveal a massive, organized arsenal of tactical guns. The camera pushes in tight on his tear-stained, enraged face as he racks the slide of a weapon with a heavy metallic click, and whispers with cold, pure vengeance: 'I will fuck that bitch and that motherfucker up.'

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband

chapters.others: His smile vanishes. His eyes widen and stop blinking, his mouth stays slightly open, and his shoulders lock in place. The clear glass vase shifts from behind his back to his side, gripped hard enough that his knuckles pale.

chapters.shot: Tight intimate profile two-shot on the upholstered bed area, Seductive Wife on frame left and The Lover on frame right, both faces sharply lit by a warm brass bedside lamp against the dark curtains. chapters.others: The Lover cups the Seductive Wife’s head with both hands, thumbs brushing near her cheekbones. She holds his gaze without looking away. He leans in and kisses her slowly, then pulls back just enough for their eyes to meet again, their faces inches apart. The only sounds are his spoken words and soft room tone: no music, no singing, no humming.

chapters.shot: Long-lens rack-focus shot from behind the couple’s shoulders toward the bedroom doorway; The Lover and Seductive Wife fall into a creamy blur in the foreground as the Military Husband snaps into sharp focus in the dark doorway, handheld camera slowly pushing in under low, shadowed practical light.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband

chapters.others: The Military Husband stands rigid in his dark dress uniform. His eyes stay wide and wet, his lips part, and the clear glass vase shakes in both hands at his side, making the flower stems quiver against the rim.

chapters.shot: Medium three-shot from inside the room facing the doorway, keeping the 180-degree line with the Military Husband on frame left and the couple on frame right; the camera makes a slow lateral slide as the Seductive Wife turns fully toward him, her face crisp in the dim bedroom light.

chapters.shot: Low, tight medium two-shot on the Seductive Wife and the Military Husband, angled so both faces are clearly visible as she steps into his space; the camera pushes in slightly at chest height while the Lover remains visible over her shoulder in softer focus.

dialogue.speaker: Seductive Wife

chapters.others: His lower eyelids shine, and his mouth pulls tight before he forces the words out. The divorce papers remain pressed against his uniform. The vase trembles near his hip, water trembling inside the clear glass.

chapters.others: The car cuts through the lane and shrinks quickly between the buildings, passing under streetlights and disappearing toward the bend.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband

chapters.others: His knees hit the floor hard. The folded divorce papers slide off his chest and land beside him. His shoulders cave forward, and the flowers tremble inside the vase as his grip tightens around the glass.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband
dialogue.line: I waited so long. I kept coming back.
dialogue.delivery: soft, broken, uneven, barely holding together

chapters.others: He bends over the vase in his lap, both hands climbing to his face while his thumbs shake near his cheeks. His eyes squeeze shut, his jaw jerks, and his breathing comes in short pulls through his nose.

chapters.shot: Low-angle medium close-up from beside the scattered divorce papers, tilting upward as the Military Husband rises from his knees; the bed and charcoal curtains sit behind him in soft blur, while the brass lamp outlines one side of his face and leaves the other side in shadow.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband

chapters.shot: Floor-level wide profile shot across the dark hardwood, slow dolly back as the Military Husband stands over the frame holding the flower-filled glass vase; his face is clearly visible above the lowered camera line, lit by the bedside lamp while the doorway and cream wall sit behind him in shadow.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband
dialogue.line: You wanted nothing from me. Fine. Take nothing.

chapters.shot: Frontal medium tracking shot backing down the dim Georgian hallway as the Military Husband steps out through the bedroom doorway; antique sconces cast warm strips across cream plaster and dark hardwood, with the plain wooden basement door visible near the rear of frame.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband
dialogue.line: I'm done crying. I'm done being weak for anyone.
dialogue.delivery: low, flat and controlled, with his jaw clenched tight

chapters.others: He turns away from the shattered glass and soaked petals behind him, shoulders stiff under the dark dress uniform. His wet eyes stay fixed ahead, his mouth pressed into a hard line, and his boots move slowly toward the basement door without hesitation.

chapters.shot: Low-angle wide shot from deep inside the pitch-black basement looking up the steep wooden stairs; the camera slowly dollies backward as the Military Husband descends, his face briefly caught by the spill of hallway light and the harsh bare bulb below.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband
dialogue.line: She doesn't get to leave me on my knees.
dialogue.delivery: quiet, tight and bitter, each word forced through his teeth

chapters.others: His silhouette grows larger on the stairs, one hand sliding along the rail. Dust shakes from the old wood under his polished boots. His eyes do not blink when the bulb catches them, and his breathing pulls through his nose in short, controlled bursts.

chapters.shot: Medium low-angle profile shot beside the brick wall, slowly panning right as the Military Husband reaches the concrete floor and moves toward a heavy sledgehammer leaning against the rough brick under the bare bulb.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband
dialogue.line: I kept this buried down here for a reason.
dialogue.delivery: steady, cold and almost conversational, with no softness left

chapters.others: He stops at the wall, lowers his chin, and wraps both hands around the sledgehammer handle. His fingers tighten until the tendons stand out. He lifts it off the brick with a dull scrape and lets the heavy head hang near his boot.

chapters.shot: Handheld wide shot under the single harsh bulb, slightly low and canted toward the rough concrete floor; the camera pushes in as the Military Husband raises the sledgehammer over a marked patch of concrete, dust glowing in the hard overhead light.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband
dialogue.line: All that calm training, and you laughed at me.
dialogue.delivery: strained, angry and controlled, rising slightly before the impact

chapters.others: His face is clear above the raised handle, lips pulled thin and eyes locked downward. He drives the sledgehammer into the concrete with both hands. The floor cracks open under the blow, sending chips, powder, and grey dust outward around his boots.

chapters.shot: Tight medium shot from the front, the open hole in the concrete low in frame; the camera makes a slow push toward the Military Husband as he hauls up a heavy metal suitcase, snaps both latches, and lifts the lid toward camera.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband
dialogue.line: You should've run when you had the chance.
dialogue.delivery: low, rough and steady, with a hard pause before the last word

chapters.shot: Extreme close-up on the Military Husband's tear-streaked, dust-smeared face with the open metal suitcase blurred below; the camera slowly pushes tighter as a dark weapon rises into the lower edge of frame, catching a hard glint from the bare bulb.

dialogue.speaker: Military Husband
dialogue.line: I will fuck that bitch and that motherfucker up.
dialogue.delivery: a cold, barely audible whisper, slow and deliberate

chapters.others: His blue eyes stay wide and dry, fixed just past the lens. He racks the slide with a heavy metallic click, the motion sharp and practiced. His nostrils flare once, his lips barely move around the whisper, and his face remains locked in place as the sound dies in the basement.
